message: A screen reader reads this heading as "delivery truck, Your order is on its way!"
fix: Leave emoji out of headings, buttons and links, and use few in text.

message: "00340434161094015902" is read as one number, not as digits: write it as "0034 0434 1610 9401 5902"
fix: Group the digits with spaces (482 913) so they're read one by one, and the reader can keep their place.

message: Its line height is 1.30 times the font size: make it 1.5
fix: Set lineHeight to 1.5 for body text.

message: This link isn't underlined and its colour is 1.42:1 against the text around it: someone who can't see the difference can't find it
fix: Underline links in running text (the default), or make the colour difference at least 3:1.

message: This button is about 72×22 px: a tap target needs at least 24×24 px, and 44 px tall is better on a phone
fix: Give the button padding so it's at least 24 px tall and wide; 44 px is better on phones.

message: This button's background (#c8e6c9) is 1.34:1 against what's behind it (#ffffff): its edge needs 3:1, or a border that is
fix: Darken the button's background, or give it a border at least 3:1 against the background.

message: A screen reader reads this button as "Track delivery truck"
fix: Leave emoji out of headings, buttons and links, and use few in text.

message: These social icons are 18 px: a tap target needs at least 24×24 px
fix: Give the button padding so it's at least 24 px tall and wide; 44 px is better on phones.

message: 1 table has no header cells and no role="presentation": a screen reader announces it as a data table
fix: Use Rows and Columns (Hyper Elements marks their tables role="presentation"), or add the role to the table in an Html block.

message: The first heading is level 2: start with one level-1 heading
fix: Start with one level-1 Heading saying what the email is about, and use Headings for its sections.
